```{r Load Libraries & Set WD}
# Load in libraries
library(sf)
```

# STEP 1: LOAD IN OHI REGIONS & CREATE 20KM BUFFER ------------------------------
 
```{r Load in the OHI Region_Key0}
Region_Key0<- read.csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/FP/v2026/CONAPESCA_Keys/Spatial_Keys/RegionKey_FINAL_May262026.csv")

colnames(Region_Key0)

Region_Key<- Region_Key0 %>%
  select(rgn_id= OHI_region_est, rgn_name= OHI_region_name) %>%
  distinct()

# Make uppercase:
Region_Key$rgn_id <- sub("^r", "R", Region_Key$rgn_id)
```

```{r Read in OHI region boundaries}
# Read in OHI region boundaries
ohi_regions <- st_read(here("spatial", "ohi_regions", "goc_ohi_rgns.shp")) %>% 
  st_make_valid()

```

# STEP 2: CALCULATE SEAGRASS "CURRENT STATUS", i.e. condition (source: Literature Review)  ------------------------------

```{r Read in CEDO seagrass data}
CEDO_seagrass.data_2025_raw <- st_read("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/Hem_data/goc_habitat_data/seagrass/Seagrass_merged.shp") %>% 
  st_zm()

```

```{r Match the land-use CRS to the ohi_regions CRS}
# Match CRSs of EDO_seagrass.data_2025_raw data to OHI regions

CEDO_seagrass.data_2025 <- st_transform(CEDO_seagrass.data_2025_raw, st_crs(ohi_regions))

```

## Assign the seagrass area to OHI regions:
```{r Assign the seagrass area to OHI regions}

# Check the area units:
area <- st_area(CEDO_seagrass.data_2025$geometry)
units(area)

SEAG_Current_Extent <- st_intersection(
  CEDO_seagrass.data_2025, ohi_regions
) %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  summarise(
    geometry = st_union(geometry),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%

  # Calculate area before adding missing regions
  mutate(
    area_km2 = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6,
    year = 2025,
    provenance = "Area estimate supplied by CEDO (2025), presumably for the year 2025"
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%

  # Add any missing regions
  tidyr::complete(
    rgn_id = paste0("Region_", 1:9),
    fill = list(
      area_km2 = NA_real_,
      year = 2025,
      provenance = "Area estimate supplied by CEDO (2025); no evidence of seagrass in this region"
    )
  )

view(SEAG_Current_Extent)

```

```{r Make a table}

SEAG_Current_Extent %>%
  mutate(
    year = 2025,
    rgn_id = gsub("_", " ", rgn_id)   # Region_1 to "Region 1"
  ) %>%
  select(rgn_id, year, area_km2) %>%
  kable(
    digits = 2,
    col.names = c('Region ID', 'Year', 'Extent (km²)'),
    align = c('c', 'c', 'r')
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c('striped', 'bordered', 'hover')
  ) %>%
  add_header_above(
    c('Seagrass Extent' = 3)
  )

```

## Save SEAG_Current_Extent
```{r Save SEAG_Current_Extent}
write.csv(

  here::here("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/_habitats/HAB_seagrass/SEA_outputs/SEAG_Extent_1.1_Nov052026.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

# PLOT EXTENT:

```{r Map of seagrass extent}
library(tmap)

tmap_mode("plot")

# Add dummy column for seagrass legend
CEDO_seagrass.data_2025$habitat <- "Seagrass"

tm_shape(ohi_regions) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "location",
    palette = c(
      "marine" = "#cceeff",
      "land" = "#f5e6c8"
    ),
    alpha = 0.5,
    border.col = "gray",
    border.lwd = 0.6,
    legend.show = FALSE
  ) +

tm_shape(CEDO_seagrass.data_2025) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "habitat",
    palette = c("Seagrass" = "#228B22"),
    alpha = 1,
    border.col = "#228B22",
    border.lwd = 0.5,
    title = "Habitat"
  ) +

tm_layout(
  title.size = 1.3,
  title.fontface = "bold",
  title.position = c(0.02, 0.98),
  frame = FALSE
) +

tm_scale_bar(position = c("left", "bottom"))

```

# STEP 3: CREATE SEAG_Current_Status DATAFRAME ------------------------------

```{r Load in seagrass SEAG_current_status scores}
# Scores are available in PDF format here:
pdf_text <- pdf_text("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/goal_prep/habitats/Seagrass_LitReview/Seagrass Lit Review (Aug 2026).pdf")

# View text from the first page
cat(pdf_text[1])
```


```{r Create composite seagrass data frame}

colnames(SEAG_Current_Extent)

SEAG_Current_Status <- SEAG_Current_Extent %>%
  # Add SEAG_current_status scores
  mutate(
    SEAG_current_status = case_when(
      rgn_id %in% c("Region_1", "Region_2", "Region_3",
                    "Region_5", "Region_7", "Region_8") ~ 54,
      rgn_id == "Region_4" ~ 31,
      rgn_id == "Region_6" ~ 100,
      rgn_id == "Region_9" ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    provenance = "estimated: current status derived from lit review (2026), area estimate supplied by CEDO (2025)",

    # Implement include/exclude criteria
    SEAG_include_exclude = case_when(
      area_km2 > 1 ~ "INCLUDE",
      TRUE ~ "EXCLUDE"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  # Final column order
  select(
    rgn_id,
    year,
    SEAG_current_status,
    area_km2,
    provenance,
    SEAG_include_exclude
  )


view(SEAG_Current_Status)

```

```{r Load in the OHI Region_Key0}
Region_Key0<- read.csv("/home/ferrer/ohi_goc_prep/FP/v2026/CONAPESCA_Keys/Spatial_Keys/RegionKey_FINAL_May262026.csv")

colnames(Region_Key0)

Region_Key<- Region_Key0 %>%
  select(rgn_id= OHI_region_est, rgn_name= OHI_region_name) %>%
  distinct()

# Make uppercase:
Region_Key$rgn_id <- sub("^r", "R", Region_Key$rgn_id)
```

```{r Join rgn_name to scores}
colnames(Region_Key)
colnames(SEAG_Current_Status)

SEAG_Current_Status <- SEAG_Current_Status %>%
  left_join(Region_Key, by = "rgn_id")
  
SEAG_Current_Status<- SEAG_Current_Status %>%
  relocate(rgn_name, .before = rgn_id)
# 9 obs., 4 vars.

```

```{r Save SEAG_Current_Status}
          row.names = FALSE)
```


# STEP 4: ESTIMATE SEAG_Pressure, the inverse of SEAG_Current_Status ------------------------------

```{r Pressure}
SEAG_Pressure <- SEAG_Current_Status %>%
  mutate(pressure = (100 - SEAG_current_status)/100) %>%
  select(rgn_name, rgn_id, year, pressure)

```

## Save SEAG_Pressure

```{r Save SEAG_Pressure}

          row.names = FALSE)
```
